name: Dhamu
description: Personal AI assistant with memory and calendar integration
detail: Built a personal AI assistant with persistent memory, Telegram bot interface, Google Calendar integration, and RAG-based knowledge retrieval using Weaviate. Designed to answer questions from a personal knowledge base and take actions on my behalf.

name: SEO Report Genius
detail: Standalone SaaS tool that crawls any URL and generates a full SEO audit report. Built and shipped solo end-to-end — from crawler logic to PDF export and billing integration.

name: Company Brain
detail: Internal knowledge base for teams that indexes documents and surfaces answers via LLM. Designed for non-technical users who need to query company documentation without digging through folders.

name: Logbook
description: Personal content engine with AI post generation
detail: A personal publishing system that generates and schedules social content from short notes. Claude drafts posts from bullet points; I review and publish.
